== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Sorry About The Mess (Japanese)|Sorry About The Mess]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67676 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(25, 9, 465, 614)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>5fd36daff7655af541964fe79dfd0cbb36e0a3113230f2dd94238ed57b813900</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
